destination.question: How can geometric and flux constructions realize GUT or Standard Model sectors, and which additional vacuum and phenomenological conditions must be satisfied?
destination.summary: Distinguishes local model building, global constructions, chirality, flavor and vacuum-control requirements.

conventions: A geometric model or proposed mechanism is not automatically a complete vacuum or current data fit

sources.title: GUTs and Exceptional Branes in F-theory - I

evidence.text: How can local F-theory geometry, including exceptional singularities, determine four-dimensional GUT gauge groups, chiral matter and Yukawa couplings through a seven-brane gauge theory with defects, without requiring a heterotic dual?

sources.title: Lectures on F-theory compactifications and model building

evidence.text: How does F-theory geometrise nonperturbative 7-brane physics, and how can elliptic fibrations, gauge flux and local spectral covers support compact SU(5) GUT models, especially hypercharge-flux breaking?

sources.title: Massive Abelian Gauge Symmetries and Fluxes in F-theory

evidence.text: How can F-theory describe geometrically massive diagonal D7-brane U(1)s and their gauge fluxes, including Stückelberg gaugings, tadpoles and induced chirality?

sources.title: Constraints on Standard Model Constructions in F-theory

evidence.text: Can F-theory Standard Model constructions simultaneously have realistic UV gauge couplings, moderate-to-large h^{1,1}, control through the supergravity approximation, and no additional seven-brane gauge sectors?

sources.title: GUTs and Exceptional Branes in F-theory - I

evidence.text: Obtain BPS equations from four-dimensional F- and D-flatness. Determine representations by branching the enhanced adjoint, and count zero modes using bundle-valued Dolbeault cohomology, Hodge theory, Serre duality and index formulas on surfaces and curves.

sources.title: Lectures on F-theory compactifications and model building

evidence.text: Use Weierstrass discriminants and Tate’s local coordinate algorithm to identify degeneration types and enhancement loci. For SU(5) along w=0, the Tate coefficients have vanishing orders (0,1,2,3,5) for (a_1,a_2,a_3,a_4,a_6).

sources.title: Massive Abelian Gauge Symmetries and Fluxes in F-theory

evidence.text: Postulate a differential and intersection algebra of non-harmonic two-, three- and four-forms; constrain it through partial integration and agreement with perturbative orientifold quantities.

sources.title: Constraints on Standard Model Constructions in F-theory

evidence.text: Toric divisor sections are represented by lattice-point monomials. Common coordinate factors diagnose compulsory divisor components and residual-discriminant factorization. Square-free divisors are analyzed using a section-counting formula involving complete faces and generalized genera.

sources.title: GUTs and Exceptional Branes in F-theory - I

evidence.text: Use the bulk holomorphic F-term −∫S Tr(F^(0,2)∧Φ) and supersymmetric defect couplings. Defect condensation sources ∂̄Aϕ=δΣ⟪σc,σ⟫, allowing meromorphic ϕ with poles along Σ. Compare its invariant polynomials with the bundle assignments and parameters of geometric singularity unfoldings.

sources.title: Lectures on F-theory compactifications and model building

evidence.text: Resolve singular fibers into intersecting P¹ curves, read their Cartan intersection structure, and interpret gauge states through reduction of the M-theory three-form and M2-branes wrapping shrinking cycles. Toric methods provide explicit resolutions for suitable hypersurfaces and complete intersections.

sources.title: TASI Lectures on Abelian and Discrete Symmetries in F-theory

evidence.text: How do global structures of elliptic and genus-one fibrations encode continuous and discrete abelian gauge symmetries, global gauge groups, charge constraints and particle-physics constructions in F-theory?

sources.title: Particle Physics Implications of F-theory

evidence.text: How can local F-theory geometries realize GUT and Standard Model ingredients, and how does their geometry constrain symmetry breaking, proton stability, flavor, supersymmetry breaking, and experimental signatures?

sources.title: Gauge symmetry breaking with fluxes and natural Standard Model structure from exceptional GUTs in F-theory

evidence.text: Can flux breaking of widespread rigid exceptional gauge groups produce the Standard Model gauge group and net chiral spectrum with small generation numbers, without tuning the geometric gauge group through complex-structure moduli?

sources.title: GUTs and Exceptional Branes in F-theory - II: Experimental Predictions

evidence.text: Can local F-theory GUTs admitting gravitational decoupling retain unification while addressing doublet-triplet splitting, proton decay, distorted mass relations, the µ problem and neutrino masses?

sources.title: Generic matter representations in 6D supergravity theories

evidence.text: Can six-dimensional generic representation types motivate common matter in four-dimensional F-theory?

sources.title: Quintessence Axion Revisited in Light of Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: Can the FN selection rule avoid an exact global symmetry? The paper nominates a gauged Z_10 subgroup for an imported charge assignment as an alternative realization.

sources.title: Discrete Gauge Symmetries by Higgsing in four-dimensional F-Theory Compactifications

evidence.text: How does Higgsing a U(1) to a discrete Z2 appear geometrically in four-dimensional F-theory, including matter recombination, Yukawa selection rules, circle-reduction states and flux compensation of the D3 tadpole?

sources.title: The F-theory geometry with most flux vacua

evidence.text: Could one elliptic Calabi–Yau fourfold dominate the statistical count of four-dimensional F-theory flux vacua, and thereby constrain likely gauge sectors and realizations of the standard model?

sources.title: Chiral spectrum of the universal tuned (SU(3) × SU(2) × U(1))/ℤ$_{6}$ 4D F-theory model

evidence.text: Does the universal tuned Standard Model gauge-group construction admit all three anomaly-free linear families of generic chiral matter through symmetry-preserving vertical flux, or does F-theory impose additional linear restrictions? What geometric restrictions affect their multiplicities?

sources.title: Large U(1) charges in F-theory

evidence.text: Can other Higgsings, exceptional groups, singular parents or compactification frameworks yield larger primitive charges? Can these Weierstrass constructions support actual four-dimensional vacua after flux and superpotential conditions are imposed?

sources.title: D-brane and F-theory Model Building

evidence.text: How can four-dimensional Type II orientifold and F-theory vacua realise the Standard Model gauge sector and chiral spectrum, and what further consistency and phenomenological conditions must such constructions satisfy?

sources.title: A Note on 4D Heterotic String Vacua, FI-terms and the Swampland

evidence.text: Which massless scalar charges can compensate the dilaton-dependent anomalous-U(1) FI term?

sources.title: Chiral Matter Multiplicities and Resolution-Independent Structure in 4D F-Theory Models

evidence.text: How can vertical fluxes and chiral indices be computed systematically in 4D F-theory, and do resolution-independent intersection structures reveal linear restrictions beyond anomaly cancellation?

sources.title: Physics as Code: From Scans to Theorems with ITP APIs in $SU(5)$ Model Building

evidence.text: Can a bounded SU(5) charge-spectrum search be replaced by a reusable Lean formalization whose witness, completion, and closure theorems certify exactly the spectra satisfying specified selection-rule and completeness requirements?

sources.title: On $E_8$ and F-Theory GUTs

evidence.text: Can E8, suitably extended beyond its adjoint spectrum, organize the Abelian symmetries and matter charges of global F-theory SU(5) GUTs whose spectra need not admit ordinary adjoint Higgsing embeddings?

sources.title: General F-theory models with tuned $(\operatorname{SU}(3) \times \operatorname{SU}(2) \times \operatorname{U}(1)) / \mathbb{Z}_6$ symmetry

evidence.text: Can an explicit parameterized Weierstrass construction realize the directly tuned Standard Model quotient gauge group with generic matter, and capture all allowed moduli for fixed gauge and divisor data?

sources.title: The Toric SO(10) F-Theory Landscape

evidence.text: Which six-dimensional SO(10) F-theory vacua arise from toric hypersurface fibrations, what are their complete massless spectra and anomalies, and can they embed proposed flux GUT models?

sources.title: Large U(1) charges from flux breaking in 4D F-theory models

evidence.text: How large can charges of massless or light fields become under a U(1) in four-dimensional F-theory, particularly a U(1) decoupled from other gauge sectors? The paper constructs large-charge examples and asks whether their charges approach a landscape upper bound.

sources.title: Flavor Hierarchy From F-theory

evidence.text: Can minimal local F-theory GUT geometry and background-flux corrections generate hierarchical quark and charged-lepton Yukawas together with the observed hierarchical CKM pattern?

sources.title: On Abelian Gauge Symmetries and Proton Decay in Global F-theory GUTs

evidence.text: When do global four-dimensional F-theory compactifications possess abelian gauge symmetries, and how can an unhiggsed U(1)X protect SU(5) GUT models against dimension-4 proton decay?

sources.title: Local Models in F-Theory and M-Theory with Three Generations

evidence.text: Can a single local ALE-fibred geometry support three generations and phenomenologically useful interactions in F-theory or M-theory, avoiding the need to assemble separately specified ultra-local patches?

sources.title: Applications of Flux Compactifications in F-Theory

evidence.text: Can flux breaking of rigid exceptional gauge groups produce Standard Model gauge symmetry, chirality and favorable phenomenology without extensive moduli tuning? How large can charges of light or massless U(1)-charged fields become in 4D F-theory?

sources.title: Supersymmetric SU(5) GUT with stabilized moduli

evidence.text: Can the extra tadpole-canceling U(1) branes support a stable vacuum with no charged scalar VEVs and predominantly D-type supersymmetry breaking? The authors propose gauge interactions as a means of communicating this hidden-sector breaking to the Standard Model.

destination.question: How do anomaly cancellation and other specified low-energy tests constrain spectra, and how are these conditions encoded or implemented geometrically?
destination.summary: Relates spectrum constraints to geometric identities, string probes and Green–Schwarz mechanisms without equating necessary consistency with constructibility.

targets: Gaps between known constructions and candidate spectra
assumptions: Resolution, regularization and coupling choices remain explicit
conventions: Continuous abelian and global discrete anomalies are distinct problems
excludes: Anomaly cancellation as a sufficient existence theorem

sources.title: Anomaly Equations and Intersection Theory

evidence.text: What geometric quantities encode abelian anomaly coefficients in six-dimensional F-theory, and how can gravitational, mixed, and gauge anomaly equations be expressed as intersection identities of resolved elliptic Calabi–Yau threefolds?

sources.title: Exotic matter on singular divisors in F-theory

evidence.text: Do the F-theory restrictions reflect general quantum-consistency conditions or only this construction framework? Outstanding tasks include global tuning completeness, independent-modulus counts after redundancy removal, and supersymmetric realizations of other anomaly-consistent exotic spectra.

sources.title: An infinite swampland of U(1) charge spectra in 6D supergravity theories

evidence.text: Can low-energy consistency explain the finite F-theory spectrum set, its divisor inequalities, and the distinction between standard and exotic geometric constructions? The source also asks how added nonabelian sectors and charged-string worldvolume physics modify the constraints.

sources.title: Generic matter representations in 6D supergravity theories

evidence.text: Which apparently consistent spectra lack known constructions after restricting to generic matter?

sources.title: Branes and the Swampland

evidence.text: Does the current-algebra budget reject the exotic SU(8) candidate that the source reports cannot be realized in F-theory?

sources.title: Swampland Bounds on the Abelian Gauge Sector

evidence.text: Does embedding the abelian current algebra into E8×E8 constrain every charged matter representation in geometric six-dimensional F-theory?

sources.title: Chiral Matter Multiplicities and Resolution-Independent Structure in 4D F-Theory Models

evidence.text: How can vertical fluxes and chiral indices be computed systematically in 4D F-theory, and do resolution-independent intersection structures reveal linear restrictions beyond anomaly cancellation?

sources.title: Group representations and the Euler characteristic of elliptically fibered Calabi-Yau threefolds

evidence.text: Give a mathematical proof of the anomaly-predicted relation between an elliptic Calabi–Yau threefold's Euler characteristic and gauge-group representations, and identify the accompanying geometric constraints under specified degeneration hypotheses.

sources.title: Anomaly Equations and Intersection Theory

evidence.text: Translate generalized Green–Schwarz anomaly factorization into intersection equations by restricting gauge fields to the full Cartan subalgebra. Multilinearity reduces the argument to vertical, Shioda, and Cartan divisor types; appendices treat the remaining type combinations.

sources.title: Exotic matter on singular divisors in F-theory

evidence.text: Transform a proposed curve configuration to a simpler degree, test the transformed singularities, and invert an admissible construction when possible. The method distinguishes genuine singular-curve obstructions from limitations of a Weierstrass ansatz.

sources.title: An infinite swampland of U(1) charge spectra in 6D supergravity theories

evidence.text: Construct a suitable nonabelian model, use two adjoints to break to U(1), and read the daughter charge spectrum. The source supplies an existence outline, while leaving the explicit abelian geometry and charge branching unshown.

sources.title: Generic matter representations in 6D supergravity theories

evidence.text: Match anomaly contributions with signed multiplicities, compensate dimensions with singlets, and inspect the neutral gain. Physical transitions additionally require available fields and a path in moduli space; anomaly equivalence alone establishes neither.

sources.title: Branes and the Swampland

evidence.text: Map bulk anomaly data and an admissible string charge to worldsheet anomalies, extract interacting central charges and current levels, and test whether required unitary current representations fit within cL.

sources.title: Swampland Bounds on the Abelian Gauge Sector

evidence.text: Turn a bulk counting problem into a finite worldsheet central-charge budget. Establish simultaneous visibility before counting factors; positivity for only a subset bounds only that subset.

sources.title: Elliptic Calabi-Yau fivefolds and 2d (0,2) F-theory landscape

evidence.text: Which compact elliptic Calabi-Yau fivefolds realize the largest known geometric field contents in 2d (0,2) F-theory, and how does gravitational anomaly cancellation constrain examples with smooth or singular fourfold bases?

sources.title: The discrete Green-Schwarz mechanism in 6D F-theory and elliptic genera of non-critical strings

evidence.text: How are global discrete gauge anomalies cancelled in six-dimensional F-theory supergravities, and how can their Green–Schwarz couplings be extracted from non-critical strings and compactification geometry?

sources.title: Automatic enhancement in 6D supergravity and F-theory models

evidence.text: Do lower-dimensional theories with eight supercharges possess an analogue of automatic enhancement beyond compactified elliptic examples? The absence of pure U(1)-charged Higgs fields motivates this question, but a universal constraint on general Calabi–Yau threefolds is not derived.

sources.title: Automatic enhancement in 6D supergravity and F-theory models

evidence.text: Can a higher-charge, non-UFD construction realize the fixed T=1 charge-one/charge-two spectrum while avoiding the enhancement seen in Morrison–Park form? Zero intersection of the two charge-three-supporting divisors is chosen to remove charge-three matter.

sources.title: Generic matter representations in 6D supergravity theories

evidence.text: Does the center action on massless matter universally determine the global gauge group in F-theory?

sources.title: Automatic enhancement in 6D supergravity and F-theory models

evidence.text: How should forced nonminimal points be incorporated into automatic enhancement: as SCFT matter, T-brane-supported exotic matter, or an obstruction to the requested low-energy theory? G₂ matter and tuned E₈ provide examples whose physical interpretation remains unresolved.

sources.title: F-Theory on Quotients of Elliptic Calabi-Yau Threefolds

evidence.text: How can six-dimensional F-theory spectra on freely acting, fibration-preserving quotients of elliptic Calabi–Yau threefolds be determined from the covering geometry and its symmetry action, including discrete gauge symmetries and strongly coupled sectors?

sources.title: Flopping and slicing: SO(4) and Spin(4)-models

evidence.text: How do crepant resolutions of colliding elliptic-fiber singularities engineer Spin(4) and SO(4), and determine their flop phases, topological invariants, matter content and six-dimensional anomaly cancellation?

sources.title: Chiral spectrum of the universal tuned (SU(3) × SU(2) × U(1))/ℤ$_{6}$ 4D F-theory model

evidence.text: Does the universal tuned Standard Model gauge-group construction admit all three anomaly-free linear families of generic chiral matter through symmetry-preserving vertical flux, or does F-theory impose additional linear restrictions? What geometric restrictions affect their multiplicities?

sources.title: D-brane and F-theory Model Building

evidence.text: How can four-dimensional Type II orientifold and F-theory vacua realise the Standard Model gauge sector and chiral spectrum, and what further consistency and phenomenological conditions must such constructions satisfy?

sources.title: The Global Gauge Group Structure of F-theory Compactification with U(1)s

evidence.text: Does the quotient derived from geometric massless states extend to massive states and strongly coupled sectors? Can singlet-lattice completeness be proved, and can the same global data constrain discrete Higgs phases or connect to weak-gravity conditions?

sources.title: Orders of vanishing and U(1) charges in F-theory

evidence.text: Which massless U(1) charge spectra occur in F-theory compactifications, beyond satisfying known low-energy consistency conditions? The paper seeks a geometric diagnostic that could help distinguish realizable spectra from an infinite set of candidate six-dimensional spectra.

sources.title: Charge completeness and the massless charge lattice in F-theory models of supergravity

evidence.text: How does F-theory geometry enforce charge completeness for connected gauge groups, and when do massless states alone generate the full charge lattice and determine the global gauge group?

sources.title: 6d $ \mathcal{N} $ = (1, 0) anomalies on S$^{1}$ and F-theory implications

evidence.text: Where are six-dimensional abelian gauge anomalies encoded after circle compactification, how does Green-Schwarz cancellation descend to five dimensions, and what does this imply for F-theory models accessible through M/F duality?

sources.title: Large U(1) charges in F-theory

evidence.text: Determine the largest massless charge in six-dimensional F-theory with one U(1) factor, accounting for charge normalization and spectator gauge symmetry. Anomaly cancellation permits apparently unlimited spectra, while the source invokes geometric finiteness to motivate an upper bound.

sources.title: The Geometry of the SU(2)$\times$ G$_2$-model

evidence.text: Determine the crepant resolutions, flop graph, fiber geometry, matter representations and topological invariants of the III+I0*ns collision, and relate them to five-dimensional Coulomb phases and six-dimensional anomaly cancellation.

sources.title: The Toric SO(10) F-Theory Landscape

evidence.text: Which six-dimensional SO(10) F-theory vacua arise from toric hypersurface fibrations, what are their complete massless spectra and anomalies, and can they embed proposed flux GUT models?

sources.title: Generic matter representations in 6D supergravity theories

evidence.text: When does existence of some admissible SU(2) spectrum imply existence of a fundamental–adjoint spectrum?

sources.title: Quantum gravity bounds on $ \mathcal{N} $ = 1 effective theories in four dimensions

evidence.text: Does the proposed smooth-base F-theory rank bound survive further tests, and can admissible base geometry yield a universal rank bound?

sources.title: The Global Gauge Group Structure of F-theory Compactification with U(1)s

evidence.text: Do geometrically correlated U(1) charges determine a central quotient of the F-theory gauge group, and can the resulting restrictions be recognized from an effective theory's particle spectrum?

sources.title: Generic matter representations in 6D supergravity theories

evidence.text: Which anomaly and positivity data specify the low-energy theories compared with F-theory?

sources.title: Enhanced gauge symmetry in 6D F-theory models and tuned elliptic Calabi-Yau threefolds

evidence.text: Which gauge and matter enhancements can be tuned over a fixed F-theory base, how closely do geometric constructions match anomaly-consistent unHiggsings, and can their Hodge shifts organize a finite classification?

sources.title: Swampland Constraints on 5d $\mathcal{N}=1$ Supergravity

evidence.text: The application seeks a required magnetic probe in a U(1)×G theory. Positive coupling coefficients and instanton masses motivate choosing the positive unit U(1) string, after perturbative charged thresholds have been absorbed.

evidence.text: Which exotic representations and large abelian charges require special geometry or ingredients beyond conventional F-theory?
